status: Extracted manufacturer STEP reference metadata, NOT a mating-cable or fabrication model

source.component_names_provenance: OCCT STEPCAF/XCAF tree; reference instance bounding boxes in global STEP coordinates
source.scope: No cable connectors/mating plugs, case mounts or direct manufacturing tolerance certification; exact PCB revision not known

step_coordinates.positive_z: front glass, looking from +Z towards board gives FRONT viewing orientation
step_coordinates.positive_y: top edge of screen in STEP viewer
step_coordinates.positive_x: right edge when viewing front of glass; USB-C on +X, I2C header on -X

usb_type_c1.role: USB port labelled USB in manufacturer rear board drawing

usb_type_c2.role: USB TO UART port labelled UART in manufacturer rear board drawing

i2c_4pin_socket.role: H7 four-pin peripheral I2C connector, inferred by four-pin edge-connector count and manufacturer port layout

reference_alignment.method: align the touch glass XY bounding box top-left to existing Rev B (X=8, V=8); front touch max Z to local inward W=0; assumption for glass flush with face, not a finalized mount
